subject: Request: preauth ledger mapping & staggered invoicing for Q4 pilot
messages:
From: Aisha Kline <procurement@brightforge.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Mark Delgado <mark.delgado@brightforge.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot — PO requirements and invoice cadence

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Procurement had a quick internal alignment and we want to clarify the accounting constraints before we move to signatures.

Quick summary of our must-haves for the Q4 pilot (BrightForge legal & AP):
- We need separate POs per BU (Infra / Data Services). Each PO will be raised against different GLs and must appear on the invoice as separate line items.
- Net60 payment terms across all POs.
- We run weekly invoice acceptance windows and require invoices to be batched on a Friday cutover.
- Preauthorization: any overage >15% of the committed slab must be flagged and preauthorized in writing prior to billing.

Can Redwood accommodate: split-ledger invoices with one consolidated PDF that contains two PO headers (we can provide sample PO numbers), weekly batching on Fridays, and a written preauth workflow for overages?

Also, we will need a 10% tiered discount for commits > $250k over the first 90 days, but we may accept a carveout where the discount only applies if the invoices are netposted on the Master PO.

Attached is our PO template and an example of the weekly batch format we expect (PO_BRIDGE-4521.pdf). Please advise what you need from our side to map ledger fields and how Redwood would reflect the discount eligibility on invoices.

Thanks,
Aisha Kline
Sr. Procurement Manager
BrightForge

Attachments: PO_BRIDGE-4521.pdf (pdf)
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Redwood pilot — PO requirements and invoice cadence

Team — forwarding BrightForge ask. They want: separate PO headers per BU on a single invoice PDF, weekly Friday batching, net60, and a preauth flow for >15% overage. Also asking about a 10% tiered discount conditional on Master PO posting.

Initial thoughts:
- Ledger mapping / invoice header: doable via our invoice metadata (we can map to two 'billingHeader' blocks and output combined PDF). Need Karthik / Finance to confirm ERP field names and whether we can include two PO numbers as root headers.
- Weekly batching: we can schedule a Friday cutover. Would prefer a Monday acceptance window (to align with our billing run) — need to confirm if their AP can move acceptance to Monday or accept our Friday->Monday flow.
- Net60: standard is fine but impacts cash conversion — Vanessa, do we have flexibility on a small early-pay discount or accelerated payment credit?
- Discount eligibility: can implement conditional discount logic tied to hubspot/deal metadata and PO flag, but legal will want the commit in the agreement.

What I need from you:
1) Karthik — sample ERP field list (GL code, cost center, BU tag) and whether our billing engine can put multiple PO headers in one PDF.
2) Vanessa — commercial take (net60 vs small early-pay trade to protect unit economics).
3) Marissa — can CS/implementation own the weekly cutover support?

I will send a draft term-sheet once we have ERP fields.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Sales Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood pilot — PO requirements and invoice cadence

Thanks — high level commercial view:

We can accept Net60 for the pilot but request a refundable onboarding credit or an early-pay 1.5% credit if they move to Net30 on the second quarter. Net60 increases DSO risk; given the pilot size I'd ask for one of the following: 1) 1% early-pay credit for Net30 conversion, or 2) a $15k refundable onboarding retainer applied to first month if payment lapses beyond Net90.

On discounts: 10% for >$250k in 90 days is steep unless committed usage is locked in the contract. If they will raise Master PO and commit forecasted MRR by BU, we can tier as: 5% at $150k, 8% at $200k, 10% at $250k. The discount should be applied on posted invoices once the Master PO ID is present on the invoice header.

Operationally: we can produce a single PDF with two PO headers. Karthik — Finance needs to confirm the field mapping below so we can turn this on:
- billingHeader.primaryPO
- billingHeader.secondaryPO
- glCode (string)
- costCenter (string)
- buTag (string)

I've attached a short diagram of the proposed invoice lanes (proposed-invoice-lane.pdf) and a draft clause for preauthorization workflow.

Vanessa
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed-invoice-lane.pdf (pdf); redwood-commitment-term-sheet.docx (docx)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Aisha Kline <procurement@brightforge.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot — PO requirements and invoice cadence

Hi Aisha / BrightForge team — copying finance and ops to confirm we can map fields as requested.

We can emit the following fields on the invoice PDF and in the invoice XML/EDIFACT export for ERP reconciliation: glCode, costCenter, buTag, primaryPO, secondaryPO, masterPOId. For the two PO headers, we'll place each PO block at the top of the invoice with a line-level relationship to invoice line items.

A few notes and asks from Finance:
1) Please confirm the exact field names your ERP expects for GL (example: GL_Account vs glCode). If you can provide one sample exported AP record we can validate mapping.
2) Preauthorization: we'll flag overages >15% in our billing pipeline and emit an automated preauth email to procurement + account owner. However, we need a signed mutual action that defines turnaround (we suggest 3 business days to approve/dispute). Without an explicit turnaround, we will hold billing for the overage and bill baseline usage.
3) Discount accrual: discounts will be calculated monthly and applied once the Master PO ID is matched to posted invoices. If BrightForge wants the discount applied retroactively, we need contractual language to allow credit memos.

If those are acceptable, we'll prepare a short addendum for signature.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Aisha Kline <procurement@brightforge.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Mark Delgado <mark.delgado@brightforge.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot — PO requirements and invoice cadence

Thanks — that all looks workable. BrightForge can:
- Provide sample AP exports (we'll send a masked CSV by EOD Thursday).
- Accept a 3 business-day turnaround on preauth; finance will approve in writing or escalate back to Redwood.
- Master PO will be added to invoices for discount reconciliation; BrightForge requests retroactive credit memos for the pilot period if the threshold is met.

Next steps from our side:
1) We'll send the AP sample and the two PO numbers (BU-Infra-9001, BU-Data-9002).
2) Please send the short addendum and a DocuSign link for signature.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Aisha

Attachments referenced: none in this message.
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Aisha Kline <procurement@brightforge.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot — PO requirements and invoice cadence

Hi Aisha — great. We'll prepare the addendum and include language for retroactive credit memos for the pilot period if thresholds are met. Expect a DocuSign link from Legal in the next 24 hours (copying Vanessa & Karthik).

Operationally, Marissa will own the Friday cutover and CS will validate the first two weekly batches with your AP contact. Karthik, please toggle the invoice lane and set the preauth flag to 15% so the first auto-alert goes to procurement + account owner when billing opens.

I'll also link the HubSpot deal for tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/BRG-4721

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

— Laura
Senior Sales Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
